message: 偵察

name: Azel
message: 「Kanji isn't important in life」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, not being able to read kanji is gonna cause problems in life. Probably」

name: Azel
message: 「There are just few kanji I can read」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey there!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Nanaka? What'd you come here for?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'What' is rude! I came here to study too, ya know!」

name: Azel
message: 「...There's no ramen for you. No Leica either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ramen? Leica?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, ahem. What part are you having trouble with, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All of it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Saying it that cheerfully doesn't really help me out」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So let me join in too\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not giving you any ramen」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You baited him with stuff?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't make it sound so shady. I just racked my brains trying to figure out how to get Azel to take the test」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you baited him with stuff」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you study for tests without a goal like ramen?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Calling it a 'goal', seriously...」

name: Azel
message: 「Irrational」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew... I really studied today!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're supposed to study every day. Besides, all you did was copy my notes the whole time. While chattering nonstop, too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Copying helps me remember it better, see」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not something I want to hear from Nanaka, who always gets by with copying...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahh, even so, Synn, you're having a rough time, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... don't remind me」

name: Paqy
message: 「Fwaaah. This is boring as hell. Let's ditch this stuff and go raise a ruckus」

name: Synn
message: 「Like shouting at the sunset? Because that won't cost any money」

name: Paqy
message: 「Forgot there was such a thing as the economy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, Azel, this is seriously bad. You can't read kanji at all」

name: Azel
message: 「...I can read ten percent」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. No wonder Synn felt like making you study even if he had to bribe you」

name: Azel
message: 「This world is going to end anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see! Why didn't I think of that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Someday, sure. Just not before the test」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh, what a harsh reality」

name: Synn
message: 「Perishing would be harsher」

name: Azel
message: 「It will not perish. It will end」

name: Synn
message: 「Either way, it's the same thing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Guess it's not really a romantic vibe after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? What's wrong, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing at all! Well, I've gotta go help out at the shop!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See ya tomorrow!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka... she left」

name: Melilot
message: 「Where is Yugiri-san?」

name: Synn
message: 「She just headed home」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems a cup of tea has gone to waste」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll drink it」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, what did that guy even come here for? Did he just take a photo, chat, and leave?」

name: Azel
message: 「Illogical」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, I see」
For some reason, Melilot looked at us as she poured tea into a teacup.

name: Melilot
message: 「So that's how it is」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Matters like this are often clearer to those not directly involved」
Behind Azel and me as we walked side by side, long, faint shadows cast by the winter sunset.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. You look like you'll be fine with math, right」

name: Azel
message: 「There is still room for improvement」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't just keep focusing on your best subjects like that」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not do it because I am good at it. I do it because there is room for improvement」

name: Synn
message: 「If you get a failing grade in Japanese, they won't let you borrow the Leica」
Come to think of it. She hasn't been brushing me off lately even when I say I'll walk her home.

name: Azel
message: 「What would you have me do?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't study math anymore at all. Instead, focus on Japanese」

name: Azel
message: 「...Japanese is merely one of countless languages」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, well, the tests are written in that Japanese」

name: Synn
message: 「And for Japanese, we'll only study just enough to avoid failing. As long as you can handle the multiple-choice questions and kanji dictation, you should be able to reach that level. Probably」

name: Azel
message: 「...Abandon the rest? Is that acceptable?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not great, but we don't have enough time left to aim any higher than that」

name: Azel
message: 「...Logical.」

name: Synn
message: 「For science, memorize every chemical formula in the test scope by rote. For English, memorize the vocabulary in the test scope the same way. Skip all applied problems in every subject except math.」
Fortunately, Azel has a good memory.

name: Azel
message: 「Rational.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's really no other way.」
Before I knew it, Azel was staring intently at my face.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What?」

name: Azel
message: 「Will you be alright?」

name: Synn
message: 「Teaching others is a good way to study, you know.」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you lose anything if I can't borrow the Leica?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe because I want to see you completely absorbed in that Leica?」

name: Azel
message: 「And what will you do once you see that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing at all. I just want to see it.」
Azel, absorbed in a Leica like a child.
An Azel unimaginable from when we first met.
I can't wait to see it.

name: Azel
message: 「That's all?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just how it is. Reasons for helping someone out, I mean.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Irrational.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe so.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's dark, isn't it. Looks just like the kind of place ghosts would come out.」

name: Misa
message: 「True. Though what comes out here would probably be Demons.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, when it's this dark...」

name: Lolotte & Misa
message: 「Fwaaaah...」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san! Sakura-kun! Yawning in the middle of patrol--you're slacking off!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry……」
I see. I didn't think I yawned, so I must have done it unconsciously.

name: Lolotte
message: 「There were indeed two yawns, though you have the pairing wrong. That was just myself and the Vice President.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I didn't yawn!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Exams are a week away, so why don't we take a break from patrolling as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「We can't really do that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, we haven't run into any demons since our fight with Pasta-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think they stopped causing trouble?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am certain of it. A student's primary duty is to study, so let's head back right now――」

name: Misa
message: 「How do you jump to such a carefree conclusion just because we haven't encountered them for a mere three days?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's either pure coincidence or they're lying low after taking heavy losses--something like that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Vice President lacks the capacity to trust people.」

name: Misa
message: 「They're not people, they're demons!」

name: Woman's Voice
message: 「What are you all doing?」
Illuminated by the lights lining the path was Ms. Sengenin.

name: Synn
message: 「Good evening.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Are you still continuing your patrol to look for suspicious individuals?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「……Enough is enough--stop playing around. I'm busy preparing for exams too, so don't give me any extra trouble.」

name: Misa
message: 「We're not playing around! This is the Student Council's」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It's playing around. How do untrained students like you expect to catch a suspicious person? Are you planning to transform like some superhero?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-How did you kn――mghhh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, with this many of us, I think any suspicious person would run away.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「And do you have any guarantee they'll run?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「You'd better not get carried away playing hero without even knowing your opponent's strength, or you'll end up getting hurt」

name: Synn
message: 「We're not playing hero--」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Besides, it's exam period right now. If you're students, you should be studying. Or are you just that confident?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course!　I'll easily avoid failing」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I look forward to seeing your grades」
With that, Ms. Sengenin walked away, her steady footsteps echoing.

name: Lolotte
message: 「That teacher. I dislike her even more now」

name: Misa
message: 「I was tempted to transform right in front of her」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, to someone who doesn't know about the Crusaders, maybe that's just how it looks」
Even so, what was Ms. Sengenin herself doing out here?
Could she be on night duty making rounds...?

name: Soltia
message: 「I won't make a move right away. Are you worried about them?」

name: Azel
message: 「No」

name: Soltia
message: 「Oh, really?　Haven't you grown quite attached to them?」

name: Azel
message: 「The Lord's will is absolute」

name: Soltia
message: 「Then, is it atonement?」

name: Azel
message: 「Atonement?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Atonement for destroying this world」

name: Azel
message: 「There is neither sin nor punishment. Everything is as the Lord wills」

name: Soltia
message: 「What an admirable zealot you are. However--」
Soltia pointed at the digital camera hanging around Azel's neck.

name: Soltia
message: 「Why are you keeping a record of a world fated to perish?」

name: Azel
message: 「To kill time」

name: Soltia
message: 「If the world you've come to love is doomed to be destroyed, you want to at least leave behind a record of it--isn't it a sentimental motive like that?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ridiculous!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Yes, it really is absurd. After all, we are going to disappear too. And of course, so will the records you've been so diligently hoarding」

name: Azel
message: 「...That's why it's just killing time」

name: Soltia
message: 「Shall we leave it at that, then?」

name: Azel
message: 「Do whatever you want」

name: Soltia
message: 「Thinking rationally, there's no way you would ever consider something like that, right?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Because you know as well as I do that this world isn't being destroyed--it's merely being recreated」

name: Ardin
message: 「Is it here?!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Is this Ryuusei Academy?!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Or is it over here?!」

name: Ardin
message: 「If it's come to this, I'll have to ask my beloved Pasta-chan where it is!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Blocked?! What the heck!」

name: Melphas
message: 「What are you doing, Ardin?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Huh? Oh, it's just you, pretty boy. Why'd you come over to me?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Self-conscious as ever, I see. I simply happened to notice an acquaintance making a scene」

name: Ardin
message: 「Who cares about that! Where the hell is Ryuusei Academy?!」

name: Melphas
message: 「It's over that way. Just follow this street--」

name: Ardin
message: 「Thanks a bunch!」

name: Melphas
message: 「...That alone won't be enough for him to find it, though」

name: Melphas
message: 「Besides, even if he does make it there, it won't be open at this hour...」
